sealed_authority.input_supervision: none; the constructor signature accepts exact W COO triplets, raster geometry, hierarchy rows, and responsibility SHAs only
sealed_authority.grid: long axis has exactly 8 cells; short axis is nearest 8*short/long with half-up integer arithmetic and minimum one
sealed_authority.primitive_mapping: maximum accumulated exact responsibility mass over blocks
sealed_authority.tie_break: smallest row-major block id on an exact mass tie
sealed_authority.output_alignment: one row per strictly increasing hierarchy primitive_rows entry in the same order
sealed_authority.permutation_invariance: triplets are canonically ordered by hierarchy-local primitive index and pixel id before hashing or accumulation
sealed_authority.duplicate_policy: a repeated pixel/primitive COO pair is rejected rather than merged

cryptographic_bindings.external: caller-provided exact raster-responsibility authority must exactly equal its expected SHA-256
cryptographic_bindings.canonical_triplets: sorted pixel ids, hierarchy-local primitive indices, and float64 weights have one content SHA-256
cryptographic_bindings.authority_digest: canonical tensor hashes, tensor bundle hash, triplet hashes, fixed grid geometry, and no-target flags are JSON-canonicalized into one SHA-256
cryptographic_bindings.replay: every helper revalidates the authority, so in-place tensor mutation and unknown expected authority fail closed

fail_closed: non-floating, non-finite, non-positive, or greater-than-one weights
front-to-back responsibility mass greater than one at a source pixel
hierarchy rows that are empty, negative, repeated, unsorted, or unmatched
invalid grid, group, mass, purity, tensor hash, bundle hash, or authority digest

tests.compatibility: 38 passed across footprint authority, hierarchy completion, query-specific propagation CV, and source-observation evidence gate
covered: portrait and landscape fixed-grid pixel-center mapping
exact dominant-mass tie to the smallest block
local and global primitive identifiers aligned to hierarchy rows
constructor signature excludes masks, labels, queries, targets, and probabilities
same group always has one fold
fold ids exactly replay the hierarchy completion SplitMix64 helper
per-pixel exact front-to-back responsibility mass is at most one
all four evidence tensors cleared over complete heldout groups
range, duplicate, SHA, row, and tensor tamper rejection

integration_decision: The pure authority core is ready for a separately frozen adapter. This closure does not modify an evaluator/exporter and does not authorize target access.
